Yoga for Diabetes | Gentle Flow for Blood Sugar Balance | 30-Min Daily Yoga
For consistency in your daily practice, join daily yoga classes on the Satvic app :
In this special Yoga for Diabetes flow, you'll be guided through gentle twists, forward bends and movements that engage the abdomen, along with slow, deep breathing. The practice works on the whole body, keeps you moving, and ends with a few calm moments of stillness.
